theme: chronological and regional graphic variation; matched external inscriptions; caption-led media and early-inventory assays
question: Does Harappa sign usage change among published period assignments, do regions differ after object-type/site-frame adjustment, and are external texts distinct from exact length/type matched core texts? The 7 October post-launch amendment also tests candidate human-sign enrichment, 3B–3C media diversity and early 2/3A inventory size against later sampling references.
outcome: The frozen 5680-face audit has 18067 known tokens and 1879 unreadable slots. Harappa 3B–3C equal-type JS is 0.190483 bits, physical-family Holm p=.044, text-closure p=.068 on a smaller population. Four of six regional family-reference tests and one of six text-closure tests pass Holm .05. Zero of 24 time and 314 regional sign tests passes BH .05. Regional equal-type/site other-minus-within losses are .638602, .274278 and -1.067560 bits/sign; matched training-component budgets reduce these to .263461, .182233 and -.030304. Seven of 42 external objects enter exact length/type matching; adjusted surprisal excess is .650896 bits/sign, interval [-.379864,1.857194], sign-flip p=.380, Holm 1.000. The registered protocol is a Frozen evaluation; subsequent support-preserving intervals and coverage additions remain Exploratory. Post-launch amendment (7 October, Exploratory): graphic candidates Wells 090/091 have raw external frequencies 7/149 and 5/149 versus core 184/17792 and 22/17792. All external target tokens occur on circular seals; none enters the seven-object matched frame, whose equal-type excesses are -.287388 and -.012277 percentage points with enrichment Holm p=1.000. Circular-class enrichment remains unsupported by matching. Harappa 3B/3C has 115/444 physical families and 5/14 exact media types. At 115 families, rarefied richness rises 4.598459 [3.191358,6.143415], Holm p=.0145; Shannon rises .901051 bits [.677074,1.144351], Holm p=.001. All 200 sampled date allocations retain positive rarefied effects. Early 2/3A has 31 readable families, 37 known tokens and 18 signs; later 31-family samples average 63.010505 signs and 128.975988 known tokens. Exact type/length support retains 27 early/12 later families, budget 12, expected inventories 10.120190/10.000000, difference .120190 [-1.435445,4.165805], Holm p=.5335. The type-only family test has Holm .043 but interval crosses zero and text-reference Holm .157. Original endpoints are unchanged; new counts and combinatorial expectations passed Verified computation checks.
challenge: Harappa has one specifically 3A face and 1095 interval-labelled faces. Region is determined by site. A 1038-face physical/text component restricts held-out support. Circular external seals have insufficient exact-type comparators. Sparse site/type cells made several primary bootstrap intervals unusable, and sparse divergence intervals lack calibration. Source checks establish site/type leads rather than row-level archaeological validation. Added assays lose all external target-bearing records through ordered-text or comparator filters. Early type/length support is restricted to pottery graffiti, with 545 later families lost; family sample size does not control known-token effort. The 3C date bin cannot locate a 2100 BCE breakpoint. Exact lecture-slide IDs, full underlying 1983/1986/1994/2008 chapters and interval coverage remain unverified.
remedy: Keep physical aliases and exact-text closure before selection, permute complete units within exact-type/multiplicity blocks, report pair-specific support and both reference populations, retain interval allocation assumptions, compare equal-size training components, preserve failed intervals and use a separately labelled Exploratory support-preserving sampler. Keep unresolved-rights witnesses and all record-level predictions local. Freeze primary graphic candidates and alternatives before counts; report circular-class losses and regional denominators. Rarefy whole families for media and inventory expectations, control early comparisons by type and observed slots, retain copied-text sensitivities and all declared date allocations. Snapshot the four updated documents and hash-check the 81 immutable prior files; keep added endpoints separate and mark origin as post-launch amendment.
retry_when: New securely contextualized Harappa 3A records or narrowed HARP interval assignments, several adequately sampled sites per region/type, independently reviewed batch/alias relations, or complete direction-resolved Gulf-type/circular-seal comparator texts. A fresh endpoint may also test calibrated sparse-divergence uncertainty under a named observation model. For the caption-led hypotheses, independently identified lecture graphics, reviewed target-bearing circular seals with same-length core support, narrower dates around 2100 with comparable excavation exposure, and early/later seal or pottery samples matched for media and readable length would sharpen the answers.
